'''Kelthan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he came to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], where he ventured in the [[Nightmare Lands]] and asked a Republic individual for assistance in combating the darkness there.
